hypotheses.statement: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 dropped significantly compared to the average of the prior three Thursdays (7, 14, 21 Nov 2024).
hypotheses.support_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 are at least 20% below the mean of 2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21.
hypotheses.refute_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 are within 5% of the prior-Thursday mean.

hypotheses.statement: Thanksgiving (a federal holiday on 28 Nov 2024) suppressed demand because many residents leave the city and businesses close.
hypotheses.support_if: 2024-11-28 is flagged as a federal holiday in whybot.us_holidays and trip count is far below the non-holiday Thursday baseline.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-11-28 is not a holiday, or holiday Thursdays in the data show no systematic dip.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather (rain, snow, or cold) on 28 Nov 2024 reduced street-hail and dispatch demand.
hypotheses.support_if: whybot.nyc_weather_daily shows measurable precipitation (prcp_mm > 5 or snow_mm > 0) or tmax_c near/below freezing on 2024-11-28, while baseline Thursdays were dry and milder.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2024-11-28 was similar to or better than baseline Thursdays.

hypotheses.statement: The drop is not unique to 28 Nov; Thursdays in late November 2024 show a general downward trend unrelated to the holiday.
hypotheses.support_if: A linear trend over Thursdays 2024-11-07 through 2024-11-28 shows a steady decline, and 28 Nov fits the trend.
hypotheses.refute_if: 28 Nov is a sharp negative outlier relative to the Thursday trend.

hypotheses.statement: The composition of trips shifted toward shorter/cheaper rides (e.g., fewer airport trips), lowering total trip count if drivers idle more.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are materially lower than on baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are within 5% of baseline Thursday averages.

hypotheses.statement: The apparent drop is an artifact of missing or delayed TLC records for 28 Nov 2024.
hypotheses.support_if: TPCDS_DB.date_dim shows no data-quality flags, but whybot.yellow_daily has an implausibly low row count or null metrics for 2024-11-28 compared to adjacent days.
hypotheses.refute_if: Metrics for 2024-11-28 are present and internally consistent (non-null, non-zero trips, reasonable averages).

queries.purpose: Return trips for target Thursday 2024-11-28 and the three prior Thursdays (2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21) to quantify the drop.
Confirm 2024-11-28 is a federal holiday (Thanksgiving) and check whether other federal-holiday Thursdays in the dataset show similar trip suppression.
Fetch precipitation (prcp_mm), snowfall (snow_mm), and max temperature (tmax_c) for 2024-11-28 and the three baseline Thursdays.
Get trips for all Thursdays in November 2024 (2024-11-07, 14, 21, 28) to assess trend vs. outlier.
Compare avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 vs. the three baseline Thursdays.
Check data completeness for 2024-11-28: non-null trips, avg_trip_distance, avg_total_amount; also verify no gap in surrounding days.

plan.rationale: H0 quantifies the metric change against a like-for-like weekday baseline. H1 tests the obvious Thanksgiving effect using the authoritative holiday table. H2 checks for weather impact with Central Park observations. H3 distinguishes a one-day holiday shock from a broader Thursday trend. H4 examines fare/distance mix shifts that could indicate behavioral change. H5 rules out data-quality artifacts. All queries stay within the 2024-04-01..2025-02-28 window and use only catalog tables.
